plates.alt: Engraving in brown ink on cream paper of a brass surveyor's compass in an open hinged case on a wooden table. The dial carries only tick marks and a vertical reference line. A green needle has swung well off that line toward a rough dark lodestone lying just beside the case, and a dotted arc on the dial marks how far it has turned. A blank folded sheet and a pair of dividers lie to the right.
plates.caption: A needle pulled off true by a stone set down beside the case. In the planted-feature experiments the probe followed the most prominent feature, a random word or a character's stated opinion, and only a check against the known answer showed it. Illustration; the experiments are reported in Farquhar et al. 2023.

plates.alt: Ledger of LIA's ten principles in two groups of five. Each row gives the principle as stated, the case it decided with the chapter where it was told, a short account of the decision, and its dated anchors on a shared timeline with a break across the middle of the twentieth century. 1, Evidence precedes assertion: the Vesuvius Challenge grand prize, where a bar of four passages of 140 characters at 85 percent was set at launch and $700,000 was paid only after anonymized review of 15 columns and a code audit, 2023 and 2024. 2, Provenance is part of the discovery: the Zenon archive, surfaced 1911, sold from about 1914 into 21 collections, relations rebuilt by the 1980 Guide. 3, Novelty is investigated, not presumed: Page, Brin and colleagues in 1998 credit citation analysis and claim only their ranking method. 4, The question may itself be the discovery: Roth, Sönmez and Ünver in 2004 pose kidney exchange as an exchange problem, after the 1974 housing-market model, the 1984 law and the 1986 proposal of two-pair exchanges. 5, Contradictions are excavation sites: Madoff's reported strategy against exchange volume, warning 2000 to exposure 2008. 6, Similarity is a lead, not proof: the survival-weighting analogy closed in 2026. 7, Time is an evidentiary constraint: Cohen and Frazzini's six-month gap on customer links for 1980 to 2004, published 2008. 8, Negative results belong in the record: the ratio-law candidate closed in 2026 with a 2024 study already in print. 9, Methods are replaceable; standards are not: Swanson by hand in 1986 and Co-Scientist by agents in 2026, both held as candidates until tested. 10, Knowledge should circulate: released scans in 2023, a 10 percent customer disclosure rule, and the four limits.
plates.caption: Each principle beside the case in which it decided something, with the dates that case puts on the record. Sources: Vesuvius Challenge 2024; Trismegistos, Archive of Zenon; Page, Brin et al. 1998; Roth, Sönmez and Ünver 2004; SEC inspector general testimony; Cohen and Frazzini 2008; Swanson 1986; Co-Scientist, Nature 2026.

plates.alt: Engraving in brown ink on cream paper of a conservation reading room. A carbonized scroll, black, cracked and flaking like a burnt log, rests on a padded wooden cradle. To its right a brass magnifier on a stand leans toward it, and beside that sits a stack of identical blank envelopes, the top one closed with a small green wax seal, with a folded blank sheet in front. Light falls from a window on the left.
plates.caption: A sealed scroll and a stack of unmarked submissions. The grand prize was paid only after papyrologists who did not know whose entry they were reading had reviewed it and a technical team had reproduced the code. Illustration; the review is described by the Vesuvius Challenge, 2024.
plates.after_heading: Similarity, time, negative results, methods, circulation

plates.alt: Cohen and Frazzini's 2008 customer-supplier study laid against the nine lines of the LIA cycle, drawn as a vertical spine of nine status discs with a dashed return loop from the last to the first. Six steps are marked done, two partly done and one not done. Define the boundary: disclosures of principal customers, 1980 to 2004, under SFAS No. 14 and from 1997 SFAS No. 131, which name any customer over 10 percent of sales. Acquire and preserve: source file named and exclusion rule stated, matched table not printed. Map: a supplier and customer node joined by a disclosed sale, with 30,622 distinct firm-year relationships, 11,484 unique supplier-customer relationships, an average customer at 20 percent of supplier sales and 78 percent of relations crossing industries. Detect the gap: Callaway Golf loses 30 percent in two days in June 2001 while Coastcast's price does not move for about two months, drawn as schematic durations. Construct the candidate: buy the fifth of suppliers whose customers did best, sell short the fifth whose customers did worst. Challenge: a dot plot from zero of abnormal returns of 1.45, 1.37 and 1.55 percent a month. Classify uncertainty: retrospective, observational, not a prospective test, not proof of cause, replication not established. Publish: findings published, unshown checks available on request. Repeat: not done by the paper; the 2008 paper becomes part of the next boundary.
plates.caption: One finance study read step by step against the cycle: it does most of the nine things in order, says how in print, and departs at the eighth. Source: Cohen and Frazzini 2008, Journal of Finance.

plates.alt: Engraving in brown ink on cream paper of an archivist's desk. A long card-catalogue drawer, pulled from a cabinet of small drawers with empty brass label holders, is packed with blank index cards. Two taller blank cards stand up at either end and a taut green thread runs between them. To the right lie three thick bound volumes with blank spines, and in the foreground a shaftless golf iron head rests on a folded cloth.
plates.caption: Two names in a filing joined into one link. Before 1998 most customers appeared as varying abbreviations, and each had to be matched to a listed company before Coastcast could be tied to Callaway Golf. Illustration; the matching procedure is from Cohen and Frazzini 2008.

plates.alt: The LIA minimal record format filled twice for Swanson's fish-oil and Raynaud's hypothesis. A table lists the 15 top-level fields with the 1986 value in one column and the 1989 value in a shaded column; nine fields change and are marked in green: claim narrows to primary Raynaud's syndrome, cutoff moves from 1986 to 1989, sources add the DiGiacomo, Kremer and Shah trial of 32 patients with median time to onset rising from 31.3 to 46.5 minutes (p = 0.04), alternatives and contradictory evidence gain entries, status moves from candidate to corroborated, validation records 5 of 11 against 1 of 9 (p = 0.05), limitations add one trial of 32 patients held as an abstract, and the next test becomes a second independent trial. Below, six status cells: candidate is fish oil 1986, corroborated is fish oil 1989, rediscovered is thalidomide in ENL from the 1965 report, rejected is the survival-weighting analogy of 2026, and validated and unresolved have no case in the chapter. Beside them a chart with novelty on one axis and validation on the other places fish oil 1986 as new and untested, fish oil 1989 as new and supported for the primary form, thalidomide in ENL as already in the record and supported, and the survival-weighting analogy as already in the record and failed. A note explains that the Antikythera reconstruction of 2006, 105 years after recovery in 1901, is new where earlier recognition of the mechanism is not.
plates.caption: One finding written twice in the proposed record format, with novelty and validity kept on separate axes. Sources: Swanson 1989; DiGiacomo, Kremer and Shah 1989.

plates.alt: Engraving in brown ink on cream paper of a clinical bench laid out like a specimen tray: a shallow glass dish of green oil capsules, a stoppered flask of pale oil, an enamel basin of cold water with floating ice, a wooden box holding two blank record cards one behind the other, and a glass thermometer lying across the foreground.
plates.caption: The materials of the 1989 test: fish oil against an olive-oil placebo, and a cold challenge timed to the onset of vasospasm. Two blank cards stand for the record as of 1986 and as of 1989. Illustration; the trial is DiGiacomo, Kremer and Shah 1989.

plates.alt: Three-part infographic. Top left, a query-driven Co-Scientist run as six stacked boxes: a scientist writes a research goal in less than one hour, a research plan configuration, a Supervisor that builds a task queue, specialized agents that work it, a terminal state that returns ranked hypotheses and an overview, and the scientist's review of roughly three hours; then the run ends. Top right, a ring of six numbered parts in a loop, corpus with dates, map, generator, challenger, evaluator and record, with challenger and evaluator filled as the parts that reject. Middle, a table pairing each part with the cycle step in LIA's wording, what already exists in the lineage, such as time-sliced evaluation, Arrowsmith's shared title terms and one-node search, Sourati and Evans's alien hypotheses, Co-Scientist's Reflection agent and its auto-evaluated Elo rating, and the eighth principle, and where each stops short. Bottom, unit charts: 741 squares for the shared title terms of an Arrowsmith search with one green square for the single syndrome found; 30 dots for a Co-Scientist leukemia run with 5 chosen and 3 positive in culture, and a second run of 3 chosen with 1 positive; and a grid showing that accept-all, reject-all and abstain-all controls are each right on one of three categories, a macro accuracy of 1/3.
plates.caption: A query-driven run set beside the cycle kept running, with the six parts read off its steps and the proportions of rejection the cases show. Sources: Co-Scientist, Nature 2026; Smalheiser and Swanson's Arrowsmith field tests, 2006; Thilakaratne et al. 2019; Sourati and Evans 2023.
plates.after_heading: The parts, taken from the cycle

plates.alt: Engraving in brown ink on cream paper of a timber ore-sorting apparatus in side view. A hopper heaped with rough grey stones feeds a long sloping grating of iron bars worked by a crank wheel and gears. Stones fall through the bars along its whole length into a long trough piled with discarded rubble, while a single green stone rolls off the lower end along a dotted arc toward a plain wooden dish.
plates.caption: A machine that runs on its own and keeps almost nothing. LIA's condition on a persistent system is that it reject more than it accepts when the evidence warrants it. Illustration; the condition is quoted from LIA v0.1.

plates.alt: Research agenda scorecard in three parts. Top, the historical replay of Tshitoyan et al. 2019 on about 3.3 million materials abstracts from 1922 to 2018: eighteen bars, one per cutoff from 2001 to 2018, each solid up to its cutoff where the top 50 unstudied materials were taken, then dashed to 2018 where later reports were counted; below, two bars from zero show a top-50 material eight times more likely to be studied as a thermoelectric within five years than a random unstudied material and three times more likely than a random material with a nonzero computed bandgap. Beside it, the three controls: training-data leakage excluded by construction, hindsight reduced by fifty candidates at each of eighteen cutoffs and three other target words, and selection bias in an answer key that scores the unstudied HgZnTe and SmInO3 as misses. Middle, the seven early priorities with status marks: historical replay a worked example; prospective excavation a single case, baricitinib named in February 2020 and the ACTT-2 trial of December 2020 reporting a median recovery of 7 days against 8; comparative performance and epistemic infrastructure partial; excavation economics, cross-domain transfer and negative knowledge not shown. Bottom, seven metric cards, three with something supplied by the cases and four not measured.
plates.caption: LIA's agenda scored by what the cases have shown: one worked replay with stated limits, one prospective case, and the rest partial or not yet attempted. Sources: Tshitoyan et al. 2019; the ACTT-2 trial, 2020; Krenn et al. 2023; Thilakaratne et al. 2019; Ke et al. 2015.

plates.alt: Engraving in brown ink on cream paper of a long wooden core box holding eighteen layered sediment cores in parallel slots, each a little longer than the one before, so that they rise in a staircase from left to right. A thin green stratum runs through several cores. A geologist's hammer lies at the lower left and a folding hand lens at the lower right.
plates.caption: Eighteen records, each cut at a later date. A replay freezes the record before the outcome and asks whether a method points to what came after. Illustration; the eighteen cutoffs are from Tshitoyan et al. 2019.
